adjudication.rationale: The migration `db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb` copies each legacy `embeddable_hosts` line directly into the new table via raw SQL (`VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`) without applying the normalization performed by `EmbeddableHost`'s `before_validation` (strips scheme and path). The new runtime check uses `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host`, which parses the referer URL and matches `where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host)`. If the migrated DB row is stored as `http://discourse.org` or `https://example.com/1234`, it will not equal `uri.host` (e.g. `discourse.org` / `example.com`), causing `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?` to return false and embeds to fail post-upgrade for such existing configurations. This regression is directly supported by the diff (migration insert + new matching logic).
